# Pinned parser distribution

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified official SheetJS Community Edition archive from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz. It is retained locally so clean installs do not depend on a temporary path or a mutable package-registry version.

SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`.

This is the locally recorded download digest, not an upstream signature. The Apache-2.0 license is included in the archive and copied to `public/licenses/sheetjs/LICENSE` for distribution. Qualification evidence and supported limits are recorded in `docs/legacy-workbook-qualification.md`.
